# Universal Packaging Group: full machine-readable reference

Canonical entity name: Universal Packaging Group
Short name: UPG
Canonical domain: https://universalpackaginggroup.com
Sales contact: quotes@universalpackaginggroup.com
Primary language: English
Markets currently planned for quoting: United States and Canada
Business model: quote-led packaging sourcing and project coordination
Primary vertical: cosmetics and beauty secondary packaging
Last reviewed: 2026-08-03

## What UPG does

UPG translates a brand's packaging brief into a reviewed structure, supplier quote, proofing route, production plan, and delivery plan. Services can include specification clarification, material and finish guidance, supplier dieline coordination, practical artwork review, proof coordination, production follow-through, and shipment planning.

UPG should not be described as an instant-price ecommerce store or as the owner of every production facility used for a project.

## Core packaging families

### Custom folding cartons

Typical applications: skincare, serum, lipstick, mascara, cream, lotion, retail secondary packaging.
Planning MOQ: typically 1,000+ units.
Production planning range: typically 10-14 business days after the required approvals.
Canonical page: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/products/custom-folding-cartons

### Custom rigid boxes

Typical applications: premium skincare, perfume, gift sets, PR kits, launch collections.
Planning MOQ: typically 500+ units.
Production planning range: typically 15-20 business days after the required approvals.
Canonical page: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/products/custom-rigid-boxes

### Custom corrugated mailer boxes

Typical applications: ecommerce shipping, subscription boxes, PR mailers, beauty launches.
Planning MOQ: typically 500+ units.
Production planning range: typically 10-15 business days after the required approvals.
Canonical page: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/products/custom-mailer-boxes

### Custom flexible pouches

Typical applications: reviewed dry goods, supplements, coffee, and personal-care refill projects.
Planning MOQ: typically 1,000+ units.
Production planning range: typically 12-18 business days after the required approvals.
Important qualification: barrier, structure, intended use, ink, market, and supplier documentation must be reviewed.
Canonical page: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/products/custom-mylar-bags

### Custom paper cups

Typical applications: reviewed cafe, event, beverage-sampling, and takeaway projects.
Planning MOQ: typically 1,000+ units.
Production planning range: typically 15-20 business days after the required approvals.
Important qualification: stock, lining or barrier, ink, intended use, market, and supplier documentation must be reviewed.
Canonical page: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/products/custom-coffee-cups

## Cosmetics information architecture

The cosmetics hub at https://universalpackaginggroup.com/cosmetics links to focused pages for skincare boxes, serum boxes, cream boxes, lotion boxes, lipstick boxes, lip gloss boxes, mascara boxes, perfume boxes, cosmetic subscription boxes, and PR boxes.

## Commercial qualifications

- An initial response is targeted within one business day; complete pricing may require further specification review.
- Planning minimums and timing ranges are not guarantees.
- Final written quotes control price, minimum quantity, scope, freight, duties, taxes, documentation, payment, and delivery terms.
- Dielines are structure-specific and should be confirmed before final artwork is prepared.
- Production begins only after the required commercial, artwork, and proof approvals.
- Regulatory, food-contact, cosmetic-contact, barrier, labeling, and jurisdiction requirements remain project-specific.

## Visual evidence boundary

Images on https://universalpackaginggroup.com/samples are labeled concept directions unless a future page explicitly identifies verified client work. They illustrate potential packaging directions and must not be cited as completed customer projects.
